items.why: Nvidia soars 31% as Jensen Huang returns as CEO, fueling AI bets across the tape.
The Nasdaq surges 6% in its best day since April 2025, so the fear gauge is falling as stocks rebound.
No single headline; moving with the broader tape.
The Nasdaq roars back 6% as Huang's Nvidia return fuels AI bets, with the Dow up 1,400 points.

market_note: Nasdaq futures up 6.76% and the VIX down 25.64% into the close.
summary: Stocks post their best day since April 2025 in a sharp rebound, led by Nvidia surging 31% on Jensen Huang's return as CEO. The Nasdaq jumps about 7% and the S&P 500 about 5% as buyers step back in.
